notes.title: Chip ‘n Clawz Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[p]Dear Chip ‘n Clawz community,[/p][p] [/p][p]You’ve asked and we’ve delivered.[/p][p] [/p][p]Recently, you’ve been consistently inquiring about future support plans, PvE mode, and a development roadmap. Yes, all of these are coming, and we are happy to share our development timeline with you![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434129/57ce6bf6764dfb4062ec3d8f1a96a4c5bb208178.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]As you can see, we're about to release a massive patch and follow it up with more content. Not only do we deliver PvE battles for you to enjoy, but we are also providing more free PvP opportunities, as now Friend’s Pass holders will be able to host their own games on select maps![/p][p] [/p][p]We are committed to supporting our game and this lovely community, and with your support in return, this will be just the first of many announcements to come.[/p][p] [/p][p]Oh, one more thing. The Steam badges, emoticons, and trading cards are now available! If you enjoy collecting all the in-game comic books and info cards, go collect all the Steam ones as well. They are pretty nice, if we do say so ourselves.[/p][p]
Keep squishing!

- The Snapshot Games team[/p]

notes.title: Thank You & A Look Ahead
notes.content:
Dear Chip ‘n Clawz community,

Thank you so much for playing and engaging with our game. After years of development, nothing is as rewarding to a game developer as finally seeing your game in the hands of players. A lot of evil brains have been squished in these first days, and that’s just the beginning!

Our priority is talking to you, watching your streams, reading your messages, and taking notes. Your feedback is invaluable, and we take it very seriously. Namely:
[list]
[*] [b]We know you want more PvE.[/b] In our initial design, we planned to keep our PvP maps, as the name suggests, player-versus-player. You guys have spoken loud and clear that PvP alone won’t be enough, and you expect to be able to play versus AI. We hear you.
[*] [b]We know you want to see a roadmap.[/b] Many of you have been asking if we have plans for future support of the game. Yes, we do! We are hard at work developing additional content for Chip ‘n Clawz, and we can’t wait to share our plans with you. To kick things off, Friend’s Pass players can expect to host PvP matches on two of the multiplayer maps with the next update. That’s right, free battles for all!
[*] [b]We know you want bug fixes.[/b] Despite being developed by a small team, our game is super stable, cross-platform, runs smoothly, including on Steam Deck! We take pride in that. That being said, we can always improve the experience and iron out those little things that annoy you. They annoy us, too. We’re on it!
[*] [b]We know you appreciate the little things.[/b] As mentioned, our game came right off the gate with a wide range of features and extras, not the least of which being the free Friend’s Pass. We want to continue developing cool things for you. For a start, expect to see Steam trading cards, emoticons, and badges very soon. "ClawzLOL" is happening!
[/list]
We want to build the best game we can for you guys, and we’re hard at work designing and implementing everything listed above. Major announcements are coming very, very soon.

We are doing things by the book – carefully evaluating and planning out each feature. We’re starting with the most important ones, so you can get them as soon as physically possible.

We ask for two things: 
1) Be just a little patient. Good things are coming, and they are coming fast.
2) Be loud! Tell us what you want to see added and improved, and tell your friends about the game. Play PvP. Use and abuse the free Friend’s pass, it’s right there!

Once again, thank you so much for these exciting first days! There are tons of Brainioids around, and things are just getting started for our Grav-Sphere-hopping duo!

Talk to you soon!

- The Snapshot Games team

notes.title: Patch Notes September 9
notes.content:
Version Number: 23185

[h3][b]Major fix:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when placing buildings on missions with pre-placed Gun Turrets (“Guns Blazing” and “Stating the Blobb-vious”).
[/list]
[h3][b]Tweaks and fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Gun Turrets now properly target General Blobbius and all of his cronies.
[*] A small rework of the mission “Stating the Blobb-vious” improves visuals and gameplay.
[*] Artillery now properly targets high-ranking Brainioids in the mission “We’re in Big B Trouble”.
[*] Janitors now properly yell when hurt, or if their doom is imminent. Poor things.
[*] Small tutorial tweak in the mission "Guns Blazing" now properly highlights Chip's Overdrive ability.
[*] A few typos were corrected.
[*] The “IDKFA” achievement now works properly. If completed, reloading your save will trigger it.
[*] A mysterious sphere named “Alien Cat Spawner” was removed from the game. Or was it?
[/list]

notes.title: Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids is Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4CjzVEu_oAE;full][/previewyoutube]
We're excited to announce that Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids is now available on Steam! In celebration of the launch, from today until September 2, Chip ‘n Clawz is 10% off.

Combining real-time strategy with action-packed combat, Chip ‘n Clawz invites players to outthink and outfight an invasion of silly brain-in-jar enemies across a vibrant world inspired by Saturday-morning cartoons and old-school comic books.

Chip ‘n Clawz vs. the Brainioids can be played solo or with a friend—online, in split-screen couch co-op, or PvP.  Collect precious Brainium crystals, build bases, and lead armies into battle. The third-person action puts the heroes right in the center of battle, allowing you to show off your combat skills and upgrade your arsenals, while issuing your armies commands. The game’s blend of action and strategy ensures an equal playing field for both tactical masterminds and newcomers alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434129/d5945ca8e0c54c32745fdfbf2348a424a43ed734.png[/img]

With the Friend’s Pass, you can join forces to save the world in online co-op... or go head-to-head to see who’s the best of the best in PvP multiplayer for free across any platform thanks to cross play support. As long as one person owns the full game, both you and a friend can play the full campaign via online co-op and play all the PvP maps available at launch.

All details on Friend’s Pass can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1332430/view/526476055078242507

notes.title: Friend’s Pass for Chip ’n Clawz vs. The Brainioids
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=V3bzlIJq9MI;full][/previewyoutube]
Long time no see, friends! While we’re in the process of adding the finishing touches to Chip ’n Clawz vs. The Brainioids (stay tuned for more details soon, including the release date!), we’ve got some great news for you already today. Introducing: Friend’s Pass!

[h3][b]What is Friend’s Pass?[/b][/h3]
With the Friend’s Pass, you can join forces to save the world in online co-op... or go head-to-head to see who’s the best of the best in PvP multiplayer for free across any platform thanks to cross play support. As long as one person owns the full game, both you and a friend can play the full campaign via online co-op and play all the PvP maps available at launch. Friend’s Pass will be available to download for free on PC, PlayStation and Xbox! 

[h3][b]How to play with Friend’s Pass[/b][/h3]
Let's look at an example: You just got Chip ’n Clawz vs. The Brainioids and you’re looking to play co-op with your bestie, but they don’t own the game. Follow these steps for unlimited multiplayer fun:
[list]
[*] You own the game (You’re set already!)
[*] Your friend downloads and installs Friend’s Pass on their platform.
[*] You share an invite code with your friend, which you’ll find in-game.
[*] Your friend joins your co-op session by entering the invite code in the game.
[*] Play the game together!
[/list]
Here’s a spiffy graphic sharing how Friend’s Pass works (spoiler alert: it’ll be so easy to get and use Friend’s Pass, even a Brainioid can do it!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434129/d5945ca8e0c54c32745fdfbf2348a424a43ed734.png[/img]
[h3][b]Try the game first![/b][/h3]
By the way, along with having the ability to join a friend’s online game session for free, Friend’s Pass owners also have the option to play the first four singleplayer levels for free to get an introduction to the game and learn how to play.

If you haven’t already, watch our new Multiplayer Overview trailer linked above, so you’ll know everything about playing together with your friends on your couch via split-screen, in online multiplayer or even against them in 1v1 or 2v2 PvP matches. The choice is yours!

notes.title: Demo Extended – Play Now!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! We’ve decided to extend the [i]Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids[/i] demo indefinitely. Whether you’ve missed out on playing during Steam Next Fest or you just can’t get enough of it, the demo is still available to everyone right now!

ICYMI: The demo gives you plenty of Chip ‘n Clawz action to dive into, as it features online and local campaign co-op and PvP multiplayer support, four Mission levels, two Challenge levels, two PvP maps, and of course, plenty of weapons, mods, collectibles and base building options!

[h3]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/h3]
Tell us about your gameplay experience and find fellow Earthlings to adventure with or to challenge in PvP [url=https://discord.com/invite/2DEGRggKA2]on our official Chip ‘n Clawz Discord[/url]. We’d love to hear from you!

[h3]QUICK DEMO FAQ [/h3]
[b]How do I download the demo?[/b]
Head to Chip ‘n Clawz Steam page, download the demo and then jump in!

[b]So, can I really play whenever I want?[/b]
Our current plans are to keep this demo up and running for the foreseeable future. We’ll let everyone if anything changes!

[b]Can I stream/capture my gameplay?[/b]
There is no NDA. Streaming/video capture and talking about the demo is highly encouraged!

[b]Is this the full game? What content is available?[/b]
It’s not the full game, just a piece of it! That said, the demo gives you plenty of Chip ‘n Clawz action, as it features online and local campaign co-op and PvP multiplayer support, four Mission levels, two Challenge levels, two PvP maps, and of course, plenty of weapons, mods, collectibles and base building options! 

[b]How do I share my feedback?[/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/2DEGRggKA2]Join our Discord![/url] Feedback can be shared in the ⁠#game-feedback channel.

[b]What do I do if I encounter an issue during the demo?[/b]
Since the game is currently in active development, you may occasionally encounter issues with your demo. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel [url=https://discord.com/invite/2DEGRggKA2]on Discord[/url] so our teams can track them.

[/b]
Since the game is currently in active development, you may occasionally encounter issues with your demo. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel [url=https://discord.com/invite/2DEGRggKA2]on Discord[/url] so our teams can track them.

notes.title: Announcing Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VCdO-C0kpVM;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re proud to reveal [i]Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids[/i], a new action-packed strategy game that combines thrilling third-person action with the strategic depth of real-time strategy (RTS) gameplay – all set in a colorful, comic book-style world brimming with a unique cast of characters. Whether strategizing in battle or diving into the action firsthand, you will find a uniquely engaging and heroic adventure that keeps you coming back for more.

[h3]PLAY THE DEMO[/h3]
As part of Steam Next Fest: February Edition from February 24 to March 3, the first-ever demo of [i]Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids[/i] will be available for you to experience this exciting heroic action RTS adventure before it launches on PC, Xbox and PlayStation this spring with cross platform play support at launch.

The demo will give you plenty of [i]Chip ‘n Clawz[/i] action to dive into, as it’ll feature online and local campaign co-op and PvP multiplayer support, four Mission levels, two Challenge levels, two PvP maps, and plenty of weapons, mods, collectibles and base building options! If you want to join the [i]Chip ‘n Clawz[/i] community and find fellow Earthlings to adventure with or challenge in PvP, [url=https://discord.gg/2DEGRggKA2]join the official [i]Chip ‘n Clawz[/i] Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434129/d3e14998ff3a4364d78efbb029197bff8f1d445e.png[/img]
[h3]ABOUT THE GAME[/h3]
From the creator of X-COM Julian Gollop and the Snapshot Games team, the developers behind Phoenix Point and Chaos Reborn, comes [i]Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids[/i], an action-strategy game that combines the enthralling gameplay of a real-time strategy (RTS) game with a third-person action adventure. In [i]Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids[/i], players will work together to put a stop to the Brainioid invasion. In this colorful comic book-inspired journey, players can take on the roles of heroes Chip, Clawz, or both characters in cooperative gameplay to gather resources and collectibles, build bases, strengthen hero abilities, command minions and fight alongside them in battle. Complete a series of story campaigns with a variety of challenges and formidable bosses in exhilarating battles, or play team-based multiplayer matches to defeat the Brainioids and save the world!
 
[h3]GAME FEATURES [/h3]
 
[h3]FUSION OF ACTION AND STRATEGY[/h3]
- Play as the heroic duo, Chip ‘n Clawz, in single-player or co-op, to put a stop to the Brainioid invasion in a humorous story campaign and challenging side missions.
- Jump right into the action in fast-paced, pick-up-and-play missions with easy-to-learn yet satisfying-to-master game mechanics that bring a modern take to classic strategy games.
- Lead the charge against the Brainioids as you build your arsenal of buildings, weapons, vehicles, and abilities!
- Assemble and command your army through the strategic Command View and fight beside them in large-scale battles.
- Boss battles against the mu-ha-highest-ranking Brainioids will put your base and minion management skills to the ultimate test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434129/c38da5a0ce9a23c31256857ef4a61d98d1401c75.png[/img]
[h3]MULTIPLE MULTIPLAYER MODES[/h3]
- Experience multiplayer mayhem in epic army battles with or against your friends.
- 2-player couch co-op to double your fun—coordinate your tactics with a friend to defeat the Brainioid forces!
- Dive into the PvP mayhem—classic online 1v1, 2v2, buddy up with a friend, or clash in split-screen 1v1 to see who's the best of the best! Couch not included.
- Jump into PvP matches or invite anyone to join your adventure campaign on PC or consoles thanks to cross-platform support.
 
[h3]COMIC BOOK STYLE AND STORYTELLING[/h3]
- Set in a bright and exciting universe that transports players into a fresh, throwback comic-book-style world.
- Meet a memorable cast of characters, each with their own story to tell during your adventures. We’re talking all sorts of brains in all sorts of jars!
- Explore every nook and cranny to discover collectibles and secrets. Rare comic books will unveil the mysteries of the Brainioid invasion, and blueprints will help you build new weapons, minion upgrades, and hero abilities.

Like us: https://www.facebook.com/ArcGames/

Watch us: https://www.youtube.com/@ArcGames

Join us: https://discord.gg/2DEGRggKA2
